name: Saturn
lede: Pale gold cloud bands wrapped by ice-and-rock rings — the icon of the outer solar system.

landmark.label: Ring plane · Cassini gap
landmark.blurb: The Cassini Division separates the bright A and B rings — a gap cleared and sculpted by orbital resonances with moons.

missions.name: Pioneer 11
missions.note: First flyby through the Saturn system.

missions.name: Voyager 1 & 2
missions.note: Ring structure and moon discoveries in stunning detail.

missions.name: Cassini–Huygens
missions.note: Thirteen-year orbiter plus Titan landing; Grand Finale plunge in 2017.

researchNotes: Saturn's rings are mostly water ice with rocky impurities, organized into thousands of ringlets. The Cassini Division is the most famous gap.
Axial tilt near 27° gives dramatic ring seasons — edge-on from Earth every ~15 years, then opening to a wide ellipse.
Titan has a thick nitrogen atmosphere and lakes of hydrocarbons. Enceladus vents water vapor from a subsurface ocean.
folklore: Named for the Roman god of agriculture and time. Ring myths of solid discs were overturned by spectroscopy and spacecraft.
carlFocus: Talk rings, Cassini Division, Titan and Enceladus. Keep Cassini–Huygens as the cornerstone mission story.
